InventoryItem.title: InventoryItem
InventoryItem.description: An item in the visual asset registry inventory

quantity.description: The current count/quantity of the item in stock

averagePriceOnline.description: The average estimated online price of the item

description.description: The item details, specs, model, etc.

imageUrl.description: The dataURL base64 or URL of the item image

imageUrls.description: A list of multiple photo dataURLs for the item

confidenceScore.description: The AI appraisal confidence score (0 to 100)

otherPossibilities.description: Alternative item matches analyzed by Gemini AI

createdAt.description: The epoch timestamp of when the item was registered

HistoryLog.title: HistoryLog
HistoryLog.description: An audit log entry tracking changes and events in the inventory

itemName.description: Name of the item related to the log

action.description: Action performed: created, updated, deleted, quantity_change, imported

timestamp.description: Epoch timestamp of when the event occurred

itemId.description: ID of the affected inventory item

category.description: Category of the affected inventory item

inventory/{itemId}.description: A collection containing all inventory items

history_logs/{logId}.description: A collection containing audit history records
